verdict.rationale: Baseten's docs have a dedicated pricing-and-limits page documenting request/token rate limits, response headers (x-ratelimit-remaining-requests) and 429 handling, an API endpoint to retrieve effective limits, tier-based escalation (Basic → Pro/Enterprise via verification), and usage/budget monitoring by API key or model. This directly matches the story of reading documented limits and how they scale across tiers before hitting them in production. Missing for 10: no explicit numeric limit tables per tier and no independent/community corroboration of actual scaling behavior in production.
